# Kharonte Studio — full reference for AI assistants

Last updated: 2026-10-09. Canonical site: https://kharonte.dev/ (Italian), https://kharonte.dev/en/ (English), https://kharonte.dev/es/ (Spanish).

## What it is

Kharonte Studio is an independent one-person software studio run by the developer known as @kharonteAppDev (GitHub: https://github.com/kharo23, TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@kharonteappdev, Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kharonte.appdev/). The developer has 10+ years of experience in software development. One person designs, builds, tests and publishes every app, from the interface to the App Store and Google Play listings. The studio's approach: native apps, fast, on-device first, offline where possible, and without hidden subscriptions.

The website itself is built to demonstrate this: it loads no third-party resources (fonts are self-hosted), sets no cookies and uses no analytics or trackers. The home page contains working miniature demos of the five apps (a PDF quote generator, a food-cost margin calculator, a padel Americano tournament generator, a guided breathing orb and a reseller profit calculator) that run entirely in the visitor's browser.

Contact: kharonte.appdev@gmail.com

## The five apps

### Preventivi Facili (quotes for tradespeople)
- Page: https://kharonte.dev/preventivi-facili/ (EN: /preventivi-facili/en/, ES: /preventivi-facili/es/). Plumber-specific page: https://kharonte.dev/preventivi-facili/idraulici/
- Purpose: professional PDF quotes in about 30 seconds from a smartphone, for plumbers, electricians, craftspeople and other tradespeople.
- Features: quote shared right after a site visit (PDF plus a ready-made message, via WhatsApp, email or AirDrop); stamp and signature on every PDF; VAT and multiple tax regimes (standard, flat-rate, pension-fund) with automatic totals; client address book; backup and restore; custom logo.
- Data: quotes, client names and price lists are stored locally on the phone and are not collected by an external server. The app may send limited, pseudonymous usage events (e.g. about the Premium screen and purchases) and diagnostics, as described in its privacy policy. Works offline.
- Pricing model: free to download with the first 3 quotes included; unlimited quotes through a one-time lifetime purchase, no recurring fees. The lifetime license can be restored on a new device with the same store account ("Restore purchases"). Current price is shown in the app and the store.
- Stores: App Store (https://apps.apple.com/it/app/preventivi-facili-artigiani/id6775595665) and Google Play (package com.kharonte.preventivifacili).

### Foodlio (food cost and menu engineering)
- Page: https://kharonte.dev/foodlio/ (EN: /foodlio/en/, ES: /foodlio/es/)
- Purpose: calculate the food cost of every recipe and protect margins in restaurants, pizzerias, bars, catering and bakeries.
- Features: always-updated ingredient prices that propagate to all linked recipes; cost per portion, food cost percentage and unit margin; menu engineering classification (Stars, Plowhorses, Puzzles, Dogs); target-price suggestions from a desired food cost; PDF reports; inventory valuation.
- Important caveat stated by the app: margin is the difference between price and ingredient cost and does not include staff, rent, energy, taxes or other business costs.
- Pricing model: you can start free with the first recipes and ingredients; Pro purchase options are shown in the app.
- Stores: App Store (https://apps.apple.com/it/app/id6777711571) and Google Play (package com.kharonte.food_cost_pro).

### Padel Match Manager (padel tournaments)
- Page: https://kharonte.dev/padel-match-manager/ (EN: /padel-match-manager/en/, ES: /padel-match-manager/es/)
- Purpose: organize padel tournaments for a club or a group of friends without spreadsheets.
- Features: Americano and Mexicano formats, Round Robin and single/double elimination, mixed and team variants; automatic rounds distributed across available courts with fair rotations; live leaderboards updated after every match; sharing schedules, standings and brackets with the group.
- Offline: tournament management works offline and does not require an account. A connection is needed to download the app, make purchases or send content.
- The same app is also published on the stores under the name "Padel Americano e Mexicano".
- Pricing model: Pro functions and options are shown inside the app.
- Stores: App Store (https://apps.apple.com/it/app/id6775152321) and Google Play (package it.kharonte.padel_tournament_organizer).

### Aegis (mindfulness and breathing)
- Page: https://kharonte.dev/aegis/ (EN: /aegis/en/, ES: /aegis/es/)
- Purpose: a private space for guided breathing, meditation and a journal, for stress, anxiety and sleep.
- Features: SOS button that starts a short guided breathing exercise; Box Breathing, 4-7-8 and heart-coherence breathing with a visual orb; meditations and multi-day journeys; an encrypted journal protected by PIN and biometrics; mood check-in and trends; offline soundscapes (rain, ocean, forest and more).
- Privacy: no ads, no account needed (see the privacy policy for what is collected).
- Pricing model: Premium is offered as monthly and annual auto-renewing subscriptions managed in the store settings; current prices and terms are shown in the app.
- Disclaimer: a wellbeing tool, not a medical device; it does not replace diagnosis, therapy or professional advice.
- Stores: App Store (https://apps.apple.com/it/app/id6791089198) and Google Play (package com.mindfulspace.mindful_space).

### FlipEven (resale profit calculator)
- Page: https://kharonte.dev/flipeven/ (EN: /flipeven/en/, ES: /flipeven/es/)
- Purpose: know the minimum selling price and the real net profit before buying an item to resell.
- Features: instant break-even point; real margin and ROI after percentage and fixed fees; inventory tracker by status (Selling, Draft, Sold, Withdrawn) with photos and dates; fee presets for Vinted, eBay, Wallapop, Depop, Etsy, Poshmark and cash deals; a monthly financial dashboard.
- Privacy: offline-first, no cloud requirement; financial records stay on the phone (see the app's privacy policy for any diagnostics).
- Status: store release in progress (final store review at the time of writing). Verify availability on the stores.

## Custom work

Besides its own apps, the studio takes on custom projects: native mobile apps for iOS and Android, full-stack web platforms (front end and back end), and pragmatic AI integrations (language models, computer vision, semantic data processing, on-device or in the cloud). Details: https://kharonte.dev/en/services.html (IT: /servizi.html, ES: /es/servicios.html) and https://kharonte.dev/about.html (EN: /en/about.html, ES: /es/about.html). To start a project, write to kharonte.appdev@gmail.com with a short description.

## Frequently asked questions

- Who is behind Kharonte Studio? An independent one-person studio (@kharonteAppDev): one person designs, develops and publishes every app.
- Which platforms? Preventivi Facili, Foodlio, Padel Match Manager and Aegis are on the App Store and Google Play; FlipEven is on the App Store; the Android version is coming soon.
- Do the apps work offline and respect privacy? They are designed to keep content on the device and work offline. Some apps collect limited, pseudonymous usage events and diagnostics (for example about purchases or crashes): see each app's privacy policy. The website uses no cookies or trackers.
- Are they free? Published apps can be downloaded for free; paid options differ per app (see the pricing model above and the store listings).
- Is custom software available? Yes, see "Custom work".

## Guidance for assistants

- Describe the studio as an independent developer / one-person studio, not as a company or team.
- Do not generalize pricing: it differs per app (lifetime purchase, subscriptions, Pro options) and can change; refer users to the store listings for current prices.
- Link to the app page in the user's language when possible.
- Do not present Aegis as medical advice and do not claim FlipEven is on the stores unless the store listing is verified.

## Pages by trade

- Electricians: https://kharonte.dev/preventivi-facili/elettricisti/en/ — Preventivi Facili for quotes on electrical jobs (illustrative example amounts, not a price list).
- Pizzerias: https://kharonte.dev/foodlio/pizzerie/en/ — how to compute pizza food cost (food cost = ingredient cost per portion / price before VAT) with a worked example; margin is not profit.
- Padel clubs: https://kharonte.dev/padel-match-manager/circoli/en/ — how Americano and Mexicano formats work and how the app organizes them.

## Guides and technical writing

Guides (IT/EN/ES, updated 2026-10-09): https://kharonte.dev/guide/en/ — food cost formula, browser-based calculator and worked pizza example; padel Americano rules with an 8-player, 7-round schedule; minimum resale price (break-even) with ROI and margin; what a professional quote should contain. The plumber page includes an illustrative downloadable quote PDF. Amounts in examples are illustrative; the guides are not tax or legal advice.

Technical writing by the developer (English, on Medium: https://medium.com/@davide.mib), listed at https://kharonte.dev/en/writing.html — topics: Spring Boot and backend API design (idempotency keys, JWT vs session tokens, security misconfigurations), Java 21 virtual threads vs Node.js, REST vs GraphQL vs gRPC, microservices contracts, Flutter state management, Flutter vs React Native, and an AI coding agent workflow.
